title: Different foundations and a shared principle

captions.emotions: Trusting a principle you both understand

meaning: Open comparison can reveal a shared principle when conclusions fit the actual content of each person’s experience.
text: A shared principle becomes more dependable through openly comparing personal foundations. The Lovers in the physical position of Ajna suggest discussing assessments freely and hearing each person’s view. Justice in energy supports conclusions proportionate to known material. The Hierophant in emotions responds with trust in an understood rule. You enjoy seeing a foundation both people grasp.

For example, you discuss what “preparing together” for a small gathering means. One person remembers the programme, the other examples and conversations from which it grew. **A shared rule gains footing when observations have their actual scale.** A finished result becomes distinguishable from the thinking that produced it. “Together” no longer needs identical actions as confirmation. Honest examination reveals different foundations of involvement. You can trust the meaning because each person’s intention becomes explainable while preserving personal views and connection with what actually happened in this particular task.

The risk is making the principle a permanent test in which every contribution needs detailed explanation. Shared language starts requiring proof instead of understanding. Proportion can apply to examination itself. Today an unnoticed aspect needed attention while another case may need simple acknowledgement. Your view retains substance when a rule reveals actual experience at its own scale and preserves both people’s free involvement.
